Task t1 completed: VMAP string parsing fix implemented successfully.

Summary of changes:
1. Added RT_STRING extraction to PE package
2. Added string resolution functions to CRIM package
3. Modified parseMAPSVMAPBlock to accept string table parameter
4. Updated dump package to use new functions
5. All tests pass, build succeeds

The fix enables proper resolution of encoded string offsets (0xD200xxxx format) using RT_STRING resources from MUI PE DLLs. EventID 566's Reason field will now show 'InputHid' instead of '32' when RT_STRING resources are available.
Task t1 completed successfully. All changes have been implemented and tested. The VMAP string parsing fix is now ready for use.
